title: The 'Old Court Verses' progress tracker (ring-ditch / king's causeway / mere-stone) appears in the status screen from turn 1 onward but never once appears under 'Quests', and only one NPC (a mere-fisher at Barrowmere) even gestures at it in passing ('a stone out there worth talking to'). Its purpose and payoff are never made discoverable through normal play.
